ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly polarized distribution; approximately 88% high-intensity white pixels (central mass) to 12% low-intensity black pixels (perimeter and tips).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region dominates the internal lobe area. Continuous low-intensity black banding mapped to the trailing edge and lateral tips. Three distinct low-intensity focal points: one irregular mark on the lower-central region of the left lobe, and two circular dark-reddish spots on the distal third of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Open V-shaped indentation with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 112 degrees and a shallow depth relative to the horizontal lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude variations range from 2 to 15 pixels in depth, creating a jagged profile against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a strong convex curve from the median notch extending to acute, tapered lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels located exclusively on the low-intensity black tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle attachment points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct circular pigmentation voids/marks on the distal right lobe and one irregular dark pigmentation anomaly on the inner-left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The fluke displays an exceptionally clean, high-reflectance white surface with minimal internal mottling or scarring compared to standard population baselines.
